name: ShowMeshRunMacro
displayHint: Asks the ShowMesh coordinator to run a macro and records the outcome locally.

args.name: macroId
args.description: The id of the ShowMesh macro to run, as shown in the ShowMesh operator UI or CLI.

name: ShowMeshPrepareSite
displayHint: Opens today's show preparation in ShowMesh and runs any configured site preparation.

name: ShowMeshRunReadiness
displayHint: Runs ShowMesh's pre-show checks for today. Start Night needs a passing result from today.

name: ShowMeshStartPreshow
displayHint: Starts the pre-show presentation for today's prepared night.

name: ShowMeshStartNight
displayHint: Starts the night: ShowMesh runs the transition into the first show, then loops shows and resting until the final show.

name: ShowMeshRequestFinalShow
displayHint: Marks the current or next show as the last one of the night.

name: ShowMeshFadeOutNight
displayHint: Ends the night after any running show finishes, and fades out the resting presentation.

name: ShowMeshPowerDownPresentation
displayHint: Ends the night and removes presentation power, where ShowMesh controls that power.
